segment_contamination_dimensions: Residential/lifestyle housing buyers (Log Homes, Wooden House, Container Homes, Prefabricated Beach House, Prefabricated Guest House, Modular Cottages, Tree House, Portable Resort siblings) — these attract permanent or semi-permanent residential and hospitality buyers, not industrial labour camp procurement buyers; names implying home living, resort, cottage, or leisure use are blocked.
Guard/security cabin buyers (Guard Huts, PVC Guard Huts siblings) — single-occupant security post structures for a distinct buyer persona; names implying guard hut or security booth use are blocked.

Office-primary bunkhouse buyers (Bunk House Office sibling) — buyers seeking a combined office-dominant unit rather than accommodation-primary labour bunkhouse; names foregrounding 'office' as the primary function are blocked.

Material-generic bunkhouse buyers (Bunkhouses sibling, Prefab Steel Bunk House sibling) — the broader 'Bunkhouses' MCAT and 'Prefab Steel Bunk House' sibling cover material-agnostic or overlapping steel bunkhouse listings; the MS Bunkhouse MCAT is specifically mild-steel-framed and labour-camp-primary, so names that are exact matches to sibling names ('Prefab Steel Bunk House', 'Bunkhouses') are blocked by name collision rule.
